vouches_for: only that, at observed_at, an unpaid request to url returned a 402 naming this amount, asset, network and payTo
how_to_buy: Call the url yourself and pay per the 402 it returns. This hub is not in the payment path and holds no seller signature: refuse if that 402 names another payTo than pay_to here, or asks for more than amount_atomic.

routes.description: Translate text to Spanish as spoken in Argentina and Uruguay (rioplatense, voseo): up to 6,000 characters from any language, keeping names, numbers, links and formatting. Use this when an agent needs Spanish copy for Argentine or Uruguayan users, such as support replies, product listings, notifications or marketing, instead of neutral or European Spanish. Optional tone: formal, neutral or casual. JSON output. Free sample at /api/translate-es/sample.

Calculate exact incoming, outgoing, net and self-transfer USDC amounts for one wallet from a supplied Base transaction receipt. Returns individual Transfer events and rejects malformed or duplicate USDC events. No live RPC lookup: receipt authenticity, chain membership and finality are not independently verified. Net flow is not a wallet balance or proof of revenue.

Consulta una página de variables u observaciones por fecha de la API pública de estadísticas v4.0 del BCRA. El filtro de texto se aplica solo a la página recibida. La serie admite un identificador de variable y fechas opcionales. Incluye URL de fuente, hora de lectura y paginación informada por BCRA. Hace una lectura sin reintentos y rechaza respuestas incompletas. No ofrece búsqueda global ni historiales completos.

Drafts a firm, courteous formal letter in Argentine Spanish using the supplied information. Supports reclamo, intimacion or solicitud and an optional requested response period. Does not verify facts or determine legal effects. If drafting fails, returns the existing template and explains its scope. Examples preserve the supplied Spanish text.

Compare two strings literally without normalization or inference. Returns equality, lengths and the first difference with Unicode code point and UTF-16 positions. Each input supports up to 20000 UTF-16 units. Does not verify file bytes, facts or delivery acceptance.

Consulta precio spot USD, capitalización y variación porcentual de 24 horas para 1 a 20 IDs de CoinGecko. Incluye fuente y hora de lectura; actualización del proveedor cuando existe. Las métricas opcionales ausentes son null; un precio ausente produce error. Una lectura por ejecución, sin reintentos automáticos. La fuente puede usar caché; sus fallos y HTTP 429 generan errores claros.

Validate an Argentine CUIT or CUIL tax id: format and check-digit verification, normalized and formatted forms, declared type (CUIT or CUIL). Use this when an agent collects Argentine customer or supplier ids and must reject typos before invoicing, KYC or onboarding. Mathematical validation only: it does not confirm registration or ownership. JSON, no model inference. Free sample at /api/cuit-ar/sample.

Hash sha256, sha512, sha1 or md5, HMAC, JWT decode (header, payload, expiry, optional HS256 check), UUID v4, base64 encode and decode, URL parse, time zone convert and unix to ISO: one deterministic op per call. Use this when an agent needs a verifiable transform without shipping its own library. Pure Node, no upstream, no model inference, nothing stored, JSON out. Free sample at /api/dev-utils/sample.

Returns possible Argentine address matches from Georef, preserving source records, URL and reading time. An optional province identifier restricts the request; records outside that province cause rejection. Results do not guarantee a unique or correct match or an exhaustive search.

Return official, blue, MEP (bolsa) and CCL rates published by DolarAPI, with buy and sell prices, source URL, reading time, source update timestamps and evidence references. Does not guarantee real-time prices or independent confirmation.

FX rates and currency conversion reference: daily exchange rates for up to 20 currencies against one base (USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, BRL, MXN, ARS and about 160 more) with rate, reference date and source URL from Frankfurter (central-bank data, MIT licence). Use this when an agent needs an official-style exchange rate to price, invoice or convert amounts and must cite where it came from. Daily rates, not intraday; JSON, no model inference. Free sample at /api/fx-rates/sample.

Receive a base64-encoded ZIP containing a Node.js lead workflow with Facebook webhook verification, HubSpot and Slack adapters, persistent recovery, tests and deployment instructions. Requires configuration and hosting. Live provider delivery has not been verified.

Argentina official gazette (Boletin Oficial) keyword search returning literal excerpts of matching notices with dates and source URLs; an optional date limits the search to that day's notices. Use this when an agent needs primary-source evidence of an Argentine regulation, decree, resolution or notice. No completeness guarantee and no legal interpretation; if the official search cannot be verified the call fails and is not settled. Free sample at /api/normativa-ar/sample.

Consulta una página de mercados públicos de Gamma o posiciones y actividad de una billetera en Data API. Los filtros y el orden de mercados se aplican solo a la página recibida. Devuelve campos originales compactos, fuente y hora de lectura. No acredita coincidencias globales, rankings ni cobertura completa de la billetera. Si la fuente falla, devuelve un error sin inventar resultados.

Summarize text with evidence: send 1 to 4,000 characters in English or Spanish and get a short summary plus 1 to 3 supporting quotes verified as exact substrings of your text, with a limitations note. Use this when an agent must condense an article, email or document and needs citations it can check before putting them in a report. Works only on the supplied text, no web retrieval, JSON out. Free sample at /api/source-bounded-summary/sample.

Extrae contenido legible y título de una página HTML pública HTTPS, como texto o Markdown simple. Una lectura sin reintentos. Elimina scripts, estilos y navegación reconocida mediante reglas heurísticas. No ejecuta JavaScript ni accede a páginas con login. El lector limita el contenido a 20.000 caracteres y se informa el recorte. La extracción del contenido principal es aproximada.

Web page to Markdown for LLMs: give a public HTTPS URL and get its main content as clean Markdown (format=markdown) or plain text, with title, character count and truncation flags; scripts, styles, navigation and ads are stripped. Use it when an agent needs to read one page for research, RAG, monitoring or summarization without a browser or API key. Also plain text, Markdown, JSON and RSS. No JavaScript rendering or login pages; up to 20,000 characters. Free sample at /api/web-read/sample.

Analyze redacted webhook JSONL for repeated received or success records and event IDs with both failure and success records. Deterministic JSON; no inference. Maximum 10000 UTF-16 code units of JSONL, 20000 UTF-8 bytes for the complete JSON request, 500 nonblank records and 1000 physical lines. Use one provider and environment per request. Counts do not prove duplicate business effects or safe retries. Reports retain event IDs; remove secrets and personal data before submitting.

Match receipt claims to individual Base USDC Transfer logs in RPC records you supply. Returns unmatched or ambiguous claims, duplicate event counts and declared-wallet exclusions. No live RPC verification or purchase attribution. Send a JSON-string bundle containing tape and evidence. Historical Bazaar snapshots remain available with operation=market_stats.

x402 payment test and ping: one call with no required parameters returns server time (ISO 8601 and Unix ms), a request id, the seller payTo, chain id and an echo of your optional text, only after a real settlement. Use this when an agent needs to prove its payment flow works, measure round-trip latency or run a cheap scheduled canary against a live seller. No upstream, no model inference; paid round trip 1 to 2 s. Free sample at /api/x402-ping/sample.

Your conditions, one fetch: status, substring, JSON value — signed pass/fail receipt. Default status 200. Public proof: check_url_sealed. Watch: check_url_changes. POST the tool inputs as JSON to paid_url with an x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header. See https://docs.cdp.coinbase.com/x402
